records.title: Shorten the path from AI idea to first prototype
records.body: Baseline: a new AI idea waits three months for a first prototype. Goal: a recorded working session produces a one-page brief the same day, and a first version within about ten days.
records.author: Aria Chen

records.title: Request backlog snapshot
records.body: Backlog is 180 open requests; 64 are in flight. This is a count of current demand, not year-over-year growth.
records.author: ops-bot

records.title: Sort the AI request backlog
records.body: 142 requests sorted by the job the model would actually do. 61 were data-quality fixes that no model could solve. Those go to the data engineers first.
records.author: Aria Chen
